name: E2E Flow Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    if: ${{ vars.E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v2
        with:
          version: 8

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Start ngrok tunnel
        id: ngrok
        run: |
          curl -sL https://bin.equinox.io/c/4VmDzA7iaHb/ngrok-stable-linux-amd64.zip -o ngrok.zip
          unzip ngrok.zip
          chmod +x ngrok
          ./ngrok http 3000 --authtoken ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }} --log=stdout > /dev/null &
          NGROK_PID=$!
          echo "NGROK_PID=$NGROK_PID" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          # Wait for tunnel to be ready
          for i in {1..30}; do
            URL=$(curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4040/api/tunnels | jq -r '.tunnels[0].public_url')
            if [ -n "$URL" ]; then
              echo "NGROK_URL=$URL" >> $GITHUB_ENV
              echo "NGROK_URL=$URL"
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: Run E2E flow tests
        env:
          E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}
          E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL: ${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}
          NGROK_URL: ${{ env.NGROK_URL }}
        run: pnpm test-e2e:flows

      - name: Stop ngrok
        if: always()
        run: |
          if [ -n "$NGROK_PID" ]; then
            kill $NGROK_PID
          fi
